## Tidepool — Landing Page Build Plan

**Design system (global):** Warm sand background (#F6F1E8), deep sea-ink text (#10262E), seafoam (#9FD3C7) and coral (#F07159) accents. Fraunces-style serif for display headlines, humanist sans for body. Soft-rendered UI mockups, rounded corners, subtle wave motifs.

**1. Nav** — Sticky, translucent sand with blur. Logo left, four links center, coral "Start free" button right.

**2. Hero** — Split 55/45. Headline: *"Plan the week together, without the Monday scramble."* Subhead names the pain: scattered standups, mystery calendars. CTAs: "Start a free week" + "See a live board." Right: mockup of a Mon–Fri board, cards gently settling like tides.

**3. Logo strip** — Six small-studio logos, ink at 40% opacity. Caption: *"Loved by teams under 25."*

**4. Problem trio** — Three cards: "Monday scramble," "Silent blockers," "Friday surprises." Playful, second-person copy naming familiar pains.

**5. How it works** — Three numbered steps in serif: *Drop in intentions → Watch capacity fill → Adjust Friday.* Each with a mini UI snippet.

**6. Feature bento** — Five tiles: shared week board, capacity meter, async check-ins, "drift alerts" when plans slip, integrations. Alternating seafoam/white tiles with live-feeling fragments.

**7. Testimonial** — One oversized serif quote, candid team photo, name and role. Metric badge: "3 hours back every week."

**8. Pricing** — Two cards: *Drift* (free) and *Crew* ($8/person/mo), monthly/annual toggle. Coral highlights on the recommended plan.

**9. FAQ** — Accordion, five questions on white, coral plus-icons.

**10. Final CTA** — Full-bleed deep-sea ink with faint wave texture. Headline: *"Make Monday the easy part."* Email field + button.

**11. Footer** — Four link columns on sand, newsletter signup, tiny animated tide-clock easter egg.

**Copy voice throughout:** calm, concrete, coastal metaphor used sparingly—never gimmicky.
final:
**Borrowed from the reference:** the day-node structure (moved *inside* the product UI, where it belongs), the hand-drawn annotation motif, and one deliberate monospace moment. **Rejected:** the 48-word run-on headline — it buries the value; ours stays under ten words, with the specifics pushed into the subhead and feature tiles.

**Global system** — Sand #F6F1E8, sea-ink #10262E, seafoam #9FD3C7, coral #F07159 (distinct from their forest green). Fraunces display, humanist sans body, IBM Plex Mono reserved strictly for "product voice" moments. Hand-drawn ink annotations appear exactly twice — signature, not wallpaper.

**1. Nav** — Sticky translucent sand with blur, coral "Start free."

**2. Hero** — Split 55/45. Headline: *"Plan the week together, without the Monday scramble."* Subhead carries the specifics: "One shared Mon–Fri board. Drop intentions Monday, watch capacity fill, catch drift before Friday." A hand-drawn coral arrow curves from headline to mockup, annotated *"your Tuesday, handled."* The mockup is built around a slim vertical day-rail — five day-nodes, today pulsing seafoam — and it's alive: one task card drifts a few pixels, then gets flagged by a coral drift-alert. Their sidebar idea, but as the product's spine rather than page chrome.

**3. Logo strip** — Six studio logos at 40% ink. *"Loved by teams under 25."*

**4. Problem trio** — "Monday scramble. Silent blockers. Friday surprises." One line of second-person copy each.

**5. How it works** — Three steps descend along a thin day-rail graphic: *Drop in intentions → Watch capacity fill → Adjust by Friday.*

**6. Feature bento** — Five tiles. Check-ins tile: a chat-style snippet set entirely in mono — our type signature. Drift-alert tile: a mono log line, *"Priya's launch slipped to Thu — 2 deps affected."* Plus shared board, capacity meter, integrations.

**7. Testimonial** — Oversized serif quote (mono is spent on product voice, not customers), candid team photo, badge: "3 hours back every week."

**8. Pricing** — *Drift* (free) / *Crew* ($8/person/mo), annual toggle, coral highlight.

**9. FAQ** — Five-item accordion, coral plus-icons.

**10. Final CTA** — Full-bleed sea-ink, faint wave texture: *"Make Monday the easy part."*

**11. Footer** — Sand, four link columns, animated tide-clock easter egg.

Copy voice stays calm and concrete; coastal metaphor rationed to two uses.
